 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<IMG SRC="g70874g0629060321444.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P><DIV STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Middleby Announces that Midera Food Processing Enters into $1 Billion Credit Agreement </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Elgin, Ill.&#8211; June&nbsp;29, 2026 &#8211;&nbsp;The Middleby Corporation (NASDAQ: MIDD) today announced that in connection with the previously <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">announced&nbsp;spin-off&nbsp;of</FONT> its Food Processing business, Midera Food Processing, Inc. (&#8220;Midera&#8221;) has entered into a five-year, $1.0&nbsp;billion credit agreement (the &#8220;Credit Agreement&#8221;)
with Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent, and other financial institutions and lenders, consisting of a $750&nbsp;million U.S. dollar revolving credit facility and a $250&nbsp;million multi-currency revolving credit facility. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;The new Credit Agreement gives us ample capacity to execute on our acquisition-driven growth strategy as we transition to a stand-alone public
company,&#8221; said Mark Salman, incoming Chief Executive Officer of Midera. &#8220;With our diversified portfolio of leading brands, strong global customer relationships, and comprehensive total line solutions, we&#8217;re positioned to be the
acquiror of choice in a fragmented market while continuing to invest in innovation and operational excellence. This level of commitment from our lenders demonstrates the strength of our business model and their confidence in our competitive position
and future trajectory.&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Tim FitzGerald, Chief Executive Officer of Middleby, added, &#8220;Midera is well positioned to accelerate growth as an
independent company and this Credit Agreement provides the balance sheet flexibility to execute their strategy. The size and terms of the credit facility are reflective of Midera&#8217;s compelling financial profile and we remain confident in
Midera&#8217;s outlook as it enters its next chapter of growth as an independent company.&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Completion of the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off,</FONT> which remains on track for July&nbsp;6, 2026, is conditioned upon the satisfaction or waiver of certain conditions, as set forth in the form of Separation and Distribution Agreement filed with the
U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) as part of Midera&#8217;s registration statement on Form 10, which was declared effective by the&nbsp;SEC&nbsp;on&nbsp;June 17, 2026. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>About The Middleby Corporation </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Middleby
Corporation is a global leader in the foodservice industry. The company develops and manufactures a broad line of solutions used in commercial foodservice and food processing. Middleby showcases its advanced solutions in the Middleby Innovation
Kitchens for commercial foodservice and industrial baking and protein Innovation Centers for food processing solutions. For more information about Middleby, please visit&nbsp;www.middleby.com. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>About Midera Food Processing </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Midera Food
Processing provides food processing equipment and automation solutions for industrial protein, bakery, and snack producers, delivering total line solutions from preparation and thermal processing through packaging. With a portfolio of 30+
industry-leading brands reaching customers across six continents, Midera helps food processors produce safer, more consistent products while improving efficiency and reducing waste at scale. Headquartered in&nbsp;Rosemont, Illinois, the company
employs approximately 2,800 people worldwide. For more information about Midera, please visit&nbsp;<U><B>www.midera.com</B></U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>Cautionary
Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This press release contains &#8220;forward-looking statements&#8221; subject to the Private
Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, including statements regarding The Middleby Corporation&#8217;s (&#8220;Middleby&#8221;) and Midera Food Processing, Inc.&#8217;s (&#8220;Midera&#8221; and each of Midera and Middleby, a
&#8220;Company&#8221;) expectations with respect to the timing of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">the&nbsp;spin-off&nbsp;of</FONT> Middleby&#8217;s Food Processing business into an independent, publicly traded company
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(the&nbsp;&#8220;Spin-off&#8221;)&nbsp;and</FONT> each Company&#8217;s future performance. Each Company cautions investors that such statements are estimates and are highly dependent upon a variety of factors. These
forward-looking statements involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors, which could cause each Company&#8217;s actual results, performance or outcomes to differ materially from those expressed or implied in the forward-looking
statements. The following are some of the important factors that could cause each Company&#8217;s actual results, performance or outcomes to differ materially from those discussed in the forward-looking statements: changing market conditions;
volatility in earnings resulting from goodwill impairment losses, which may occur irregularly and in varying amounts; variability in financing costs and interest rates; quarterly variations in operating results; dependence on key customers; risks

risk associated with the exposure to foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations; each Company&#8217;s ability to protect its trademarks, copyrights and other intellectual property; changing market conditions,
